builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Tryndamere: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee attack carry who builds Fury for crit chance, spins to maintain contact and uses temporary death immunity to extend a finishing window. Fix Fury crit chance and spin resets. R's death immunity has finite duration; healing and resistances must compare how many attacks land before it ends. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Tryndamere: Fix Fury crit chance and spin resets. R's death immunity has finite duration; healing and resistances must compare how many attacks land before it ends.
